title: USCGC Polar Star (WAGB 10) ice pilots
description: U.S. Coast Guard Cutter Polar Star (WAGB 10) crewmembers speak about their experiences as ice pilots while at McMurdo Station, Antarctica, Feb. 12, 2025. Ice pilots are specially trained Coast Guard deck watch officers who navigate icebreakers in and around ice in the Arctic and Antarctic regions. (U.S. Coast Guard video by Petty Officer 2nd Class Briana Carter)
keywords: icebreaker, Ice Operations, USCG PolarOps, Ice Pilot
